# StupidMirror

> StupidMirror is a native macOS app (macOS 15+) that mirrors and controls real iPhone and Android devices, plus booted iOS Simulators and Android emulators, and exposes them to AI agents through a local MCP server and a bundled Codex plugin.

- Website: https://stupidmirror.itool.tech/ (Chinese: https://stupidmirror.itool.tech/zh/)
- Download: https://github.com/LiuTianjie/StupidMirror/releases/latest
- Source: https://github.com/LiuTianjie/StupidMirror (PolyForm Noncommercial; commercial use needs separate authorization)

## What it does

- iPhone over USB (AVFoundation capture) or Wi-Fi (H.264 through a CoreDevice tunnel, after a one-time USB setup).
- Android 11+ over ADB, video and audio from scrcpy; control through Appium and UiAutomator2.
- iPhone control through WebDriverAgent; taps, swipes, text input, device buttons, app launch and termination.
- Local Apple Vision OCR, optional accessibility trees, semantic targeting, waits and assertions for agents.
- Codex plugin shows the live phone screen inside the chat over encrypted local WebRTC; Claude Code and other MCP clients connect to the localhost MCP server. No model API key is needed.

## Pricing

One device can be mirrored and controlled without signing in. An SM- activation code unlocks several devices at once.
